differences.native: MySQL's / operator divides the two integer counts as a decimal value before ROUND is applied.
differences.app: SQLite multiplies the numerator by 1.0 so / performs real rather than integer division before the same ROUND call.
differences.rationale: The cast is the SQLite-compatible expression of the identical reaction-count ratio; every CTE, predicate, projection, alias, and ordering rule remains the same.
